the wheel holds no git metadata, tracker database, cache, virtual environment, test tree, recorded run or coverage output; every member sits under techtree/ or techtree-0.1.0.dist-info/, and the 155 payload members are the package and its resources and nothing else. techtree/runs/ and techtree/drafts/ are the package's own source modules, not recorded output

no member carries a private key block, a provider key, or a credential assignment with a value. The one string the scanner stopped on, secret = "findings" in techtree/skills/service.py, is a local boolean naming a scanner result code, not a credential
the wheel is version 0.1.0, which is the pyproject_version release/build-info.json records as the input to this ReleaseCore, and the version the release names

release_contract_note: The packaged ReleaseCore is a contract: every coordinate in it is one a person chose, and it describes no artifact of its own (decision 0026). This wheel's identity is the stamp above, written during the build and absent from the committed tree.

wheel.built_from: a clean clone of commit 8d9068cfca818d3ae39f7ea130a90f596b33d4f5, built with `uv build --wheel`. The commit is not asserted here: the build hook (tools/stamp_provenance.py) asked git which commit the packaged sources are and refused to write a stamp for anything else, and the stamp read back out of the wheel is the value recorded above (decision 0026 section 2).
wheel.member_count_note: 160 members: 155 payload plus the 5 dist-info files. One payload member more than the previous inspection of this package — techtree/py.typed now ships, the marker that tells a type checker reading an installed techtree that the package is typed (techtree-python-qgr).

reproducible.detail: NOT re-observed by this inspection. The two-clean-clone double build of 8d9068cfca818d3ae39f7ea130a90f596b33d4f5 was performed by the orchestrating session before this record was written and was not repeated here, so this inspection makes no first-hand reproducibility claim. What this inspection did read for itself: the wheel in dist/ hashes to sha256:90a543ca7353e38b4fa3d8fb16a2c190d59308fc2c84222141ce8f38cc37b49a, and the provenance stamp inside it names 8d9068cfca818d3ae39f7ea130a90f596b33d4f5.
